Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the cemetery setting, add one concrete sight or sound to make the place vivid: “墓地里常常有人哭，也有人烧纸。”
2. After the children’s game, add Meng’s mother’s feeling: “孟母看见了，觉得很着急。”
3. At the shops, show why the area is noisy with specific actions: “商人一直叫卖，客人讨价还价。”

ideas.reason: It adds concrete, story-appropriate cemetery details in simple Chinese.
